notes: await sharp(bytes).resize(width, height).png().toBuffer(), default options: the Lanczos3 kernel, fit cover (nothing is cropped at the exact aspect ratio). sharp.cache(false) and sharp.concurrency(1) are called once at load, so libvips neither answers a repeated decode from its operation cache nor works on more than one thread. The work still runs on libuv pool threads and libvips helper threads while the JavaScript thread waits; CPU counts every thread. A native add-on (libvips behind N-API), installed as a prebuilt binary.
